headline: President Clinton changed an earlier executive order, No. 12975, which had set up a national advisory panel on bioethics.
what_it_does: This order changes the text of Executive Order 12975. That earlier 1995 order created the National Bioethics Advisory Commission, which advised the government on ethical issues in research and medicine. The title does not say what specific changes were made, so the details are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the National Bioethics Advisory Commission
who_it_affects.how: The rules that set up and guide their commission may have been changed.
